batting.name: VR Iyer
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b SN Thakur

batting.name: EJG Morgan
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b JR Hazlewood

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b JR Hazlewood

batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b AD Russell

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c LH Ferguson b M Prasidh Krishna

batting.name: MM Ali
batting.dismissal: c VR Iyer b LH Ferguson

batting.name: SM Curran
batting.dismissal: c KL Nagarkoti b SP Narine

balls.text: full, smacked down the ground. Thakur and du Plessis go for the ball, converging from long-off and long-on, respectively. Thakur has tried to skip it back, but just misses, and du Plessis overruns it a touch!

this is interesting! A review for caught behind, after a missed opportunity for a run out! It's a full ball, and there did seem to be a bit of a noise, but most likely bat hitting ground. Dhoni collects and has a shy at the stumps as they scamper through. Late review, but the decision of not out will stand

gone this time? It's a yorker, and he was looking to run it down towards third man. Collected by Dhoni. It's an umpire's review, but does look out at first glance. Possibly an intended drive to a full ball, with an open face of the bat, but just off the edge.

this is strange, but effective! Karthik shuffles around and Hazlewood bangs it on short. Karthik looks to pull this, but it runs off the top of his blade, and perhaps a bit of glove, and pops up over the vacant slips cordon
yorker, angles in, and he works this towards midwicket. Shardul Thakur *stop the press* misfields, and that allows them to come back for two
full toss, but he can only drive it down to long off
yorker, but misdirected. Way beyond the tramlines on the offside
worked over short fine leg. Curran travels for 56 off his four. Length ball, around the stumps, but Karthik had moved across to the off side to turn it into a leg side long hop. Superb from DK!
yorker, tailing in towards leg stump, and dug out towards the off side. Easy single

moves across to the off side, and pushes a full ball to cover. They go through for a single after an initial bit of hesitation. But Rayudu doesn't throw at the stumps, perhaps concerned about overthrows
wide yorker again, and he works his way towards the ball, and then slaps it back down the ground. Hustles through for two, when he realises this is not going to beat long off
full, wide of off. Karthik looks to get some bat on it, but fails to do so. Called a wide, which is perhaps a touch harsh on Curran, but it was very wide at first glance
looks to go down the ground, but it runs off the edge. To the right of Dhoni, and well wide of short third. Gets four for that as well
shot! Curran looks for the yorker, and Karthik stays deep in the crease and just whips this away towards deep midwicket. There's a fielder there, and he has cleared that man quite well in the end
yorker, worked away towards deep square leg. Moeen Ali converges on this quickly from deep backward square, and keeps it down to one

this time he backs away towards the offside, and swings it around, but straight towards the man at fine leg. Berates himself immediately after that shot. Has a man hanging around with some spare bats for him after this final ball, one would think
down the wicket, inside out, and through for four. Chahar was probably looking for the yorker, but has ended up serving up a decent, juicy half-volley. Well played, nevertheless
skips down the wicket, and Chahar responds with a slower ball around leg. Swung around towards deep backward square leg for four
length, outside off, and he cuts this away to the right of point. Quick single taken
fullish length, driven to long off
full toss, and he backs away to drive this firmly to deep point
full, on the pads, whipped away towards fine leg

gone! Dre Russ is Lord Shardul's latest exploit. It's not a great shot, to be perfectly honest. It's a length ball, just around off, and possibly a subtle change of pace. Russell has wound himself into action and then looked to spank this over midwicket. Just gets the inside edge, and on to the stumps. Quietly makes his way off. That could save Chennai some 20-25 runs right there, you never know...
Rana moves to his left this time. Thakur follows him with a fullish ball, and he can only drive it down to long off
yorker, and Rana moves away to open up the off side, but squirts it away towards fine leg. They sprint through for two, and he had to hurry through towards the end
fullish, slower ball, well outside off. Russell digs it out, towards deep backward point, where Dhoni has stationed a man to protect the boundary
slower ball, off cutter, and he fails to make contact as he winds up for a big heave across the line. Not far from the off-stump either
full toss, well wide of off. Will have to redo this one
smart bowling again. Rana looks to move away to his off side and open up the area over short fine. Chahar follows him with a slowish bouncer. He fails to make contact

short, and he slaps this away. More of a forehand crosscourt, but this goes along the ground to deep midwicket. Perhaps an indication of the two-paced nature (or slow nature, to be more precise) of this surface
yorker. Fabulous! Tails in as Russell looks to make room by backing away. In the end, he just jams his bat against the ground
length, and he looks to nurdle this beyond short fine leg. Just about stopped there, and they pinch a single. Sensible. Get the Big Guy on strike...
fullish, around off, and he looks to reverse lap this. Just misses out on contact, and also goes quite close to his off stump

he's had a go at this, and smacked him over long-on! Curran just making the mistake of bowling length here, and the line is predictably just wide of off. Russell sets up a low base, and whirs his massive arms and wrists into action. Perhaps not off the middle, but with AD Russell, when has that ever mattered?
short, angles across. He has a waft, but misses out. Decent bounce on this, but did well to keep it well beyond Russell's right shoulder
this is short, wide, and asking for punishment. Russell slashes this over point. Nobody at deep backward point and that allows him to pick up four easy runs
slower, angled across, and under-edge through to Dhoni again
looks to whip this away, and gets it away towards fine leg in the process. The man inside the ring, so that runs away for four
angled across, and wide of off. Russell has to reach out for that, but only gets an under-edge through to Dhoni
angles in towards his pads, and he has worked this away towards deep backward square
length, driven towards long off, and they pick up a single
length, and he whips this away with a wristy flourish, and clears midwicket quite comfortably. Did well to stay deep and that gave him ample room to take it all the way
short, down the legside. Not far from the bat, as Rana looks to launch into a pull, but that will be a wide
makes some room and shovels this towards deep midwicket. Hazlewood followed him just a touch to ensure he is cramped for room
length, angles in, and he defends this from the crease
back of a length, around leg and middle. Rana wants to work this away through the onside, but misses. They sneak a leg bye towards point
works this with the turn towards deep square leg
length, and he looks to smash this across the line. Just off the lower portion of the bat, going towards deep midwicket
length, swept from outside off, towards deep square leg
fullish, around off, and driven towards sweeper cover

speared in quickly, and Tripathi seems to have pre-meditated a reverse sweep. More of a swipe in the end, as he realises the ball is far too full for that shot. Ends up very late on that, as it crashes into the base of off-stump. Just reward for what has been a spell of very clever bowling from Jadeja
length, wide of off, goes for the drive, but cannot beat a diving Rayudu at cover
length, patted towards cover
dug in short, and he's a bit early on a pull. Just hits his armpit and goes off towards point
short of a length, a bit slow too. He uses whatever little pace is available, and the incoming angle, to play it down towards deep backward square leg
scrambled seam, fuller around off, and he nudges it through the gully region, down to third man
just a touch short in length, and he chips it throgh the vacant midwicket area. They scamper two before long on can come around to field this
length, driven towards long on with the incoming slant
fullish, outside off, and drives him towards sweeper cover
full, around the pads, worked away towards Gaikwad. He's much squarer now
drives a length ball towards sweeper cover
pulls out the sweep. Outstanding work by Gaikwad, sliding across to his left after running in from deep backward square leg. Keeps them down to just the one
short of a length, outside off, and bashed away towards Sam Curran at sweeper cover
works one with the turn, from around the stumps, towards deep midwicket
full delivery on his pads, as he clips it to the right of long-on from deep in his crease
fullish ball on middle and leg, and that is clipped to deep square leg
pulls this short of a length ball on off to deep square leg
cuts that fiercely to deep point! Short of a length and wide of off, and he plays forcefully to the left of point, who is left unmoved
good length ball on off, and he skips in his crease to dab that to point with the open face of the bat

du Plessis completes a tight catch at the long-on fence! He hsa taken the catch, but knows that the boundary line is just behind him. So he pops the ball back and goes inside the rope. And by the time he is out again, there is enough time for him to complete that take easily. That was coming high and quick to him, as Morgan slapped that good length ball on middle after coming down and making room. Another low score for Morgan
crunches this full ball on off to Moeen at cover
goes down to sweep this full ball on middle and leg, but gets that on the bounce to fine leg
very full on off, and clipped to the left on long-on for a rapid two
sweeps that full ball on off to deep square leg
Morgan makes room to go way outside leg. Jadeja follows him to on a good length outside leg, and pushes that to long-on
very full and straight on middle. Driven with the full face of the bat to long-off
short delivery on middle and leg, and with good bounce. Morgan pulls, but gets it on to his body instead
skips down this short ball just outside off, and dabs that to third man rather uncomfortably with that bounce
Jadeja at point flies to his right, but doesn't get a hand. Tripathi flashes at that short ball wide of off, and gets four down to deep point's left
ramps that over Dhoni, who turns around and gives the chase. Good length ball on middle, and he stands across off to scoop that just over the keeper's head
comes down the track and makes room to this good length ball outside off, but gets a bottom edge to his slash
du Plessis back on the field at mid-off, and he throws at the bowler's end to keep Tripathi in check. It is a full ball just outside off, and Tripathi took off immediately
reverse-sweeps this full ball on off, and beats short third man to his right. Rayudu gives the chase from across the leg side after running right down to the fence
back of a length on off, and clips to midwicket. Moeen dives to his right to stop that
another sweep to the full ball on off, and finds the man at fine leg again
good length ball just outside off, pushed to long-off as Morgan is finally off the mark
goes down to sweep this full ball on middle, and plays to fine leg
full ball on off, and tapped toward cover
wicket-maiden for Thakur! Keeps it on a good length just outside off, and continues to bowl tight, as Morgan pushes at that toward cover again
another good length ball on middle, and Morgan dabs at that to cover-point for another dot ball. That is now five in a row
taps this full delivery just outside toward cover, with a good stride forward
good length ball on off, and Morgan cuts that to cover from close to his body
fullish length and wide of off. He cuts that to cover-point

and Iyer edges behind first ball! But he reviews belatedly. More drama, as if what we have had so far wasn't enough. Iyer goes flashing at that full delivery wide of off, as he plays with foot movement and away from his body. There is a clear edge, as UltraEdge confirms, and Iyer has to finally walk back
good length ball on leg, which doesn't quite bounce. Pulled to fine leg with a swivel to raise the side's fifty in five overs
another good length ball on middle and leg, but this is clipped to midwicket, who is right on the edge of the circle
ramped over the keeper, and four more down third man! Stays deep in his crease to this short of a length ball just outside off, and simply lofts that close to his body
comes down to this good length ball on off, and pushes that to mid-off after making room

and again he beats short third man with that dab! Good length ball outside off, and he dabs that late to land that just short of short third man, where Raina dives to his left to try and stop that, but can't get a hand
good length ball on off, and he gets good bounce too. Clipped to deep square after riding the bounce
full delivery on middle, and clipped toward midwicket to complete an action-packed over
lofted inside-out over cover! That was in the slot on a full length on off, as he opens the bat face to lift that powerfully

taken by Dhoni rather smartly! He stretches out his right hand above him, as the ball flicks his glove only to drop back into both his gloves for him to eventually complete the take. But the umpires have asked Tripathi to wait. More drama then? It was a short delivery climbing on to the batter, with replays showing the ball even went over his head as he tried to ramp that. And it is called no-ball for height, as Dhoni is not happy
comes down the track to this good length ball on middle and leg, and clips that toward deep square leg
tennis-bats that short of a length ball on off, which is rising on to him, toward mid-off for a quick single
dive by Hazlewood at mid-off, but in vain! Another scrambled seam ball on a fullish length on off, as he drives forward to the left of mid-off, as Hazlewood runs across and dives, but can't stop that
change of pace again. On a good length and pitching on to angle away. He has a poke at that, but is beaten while playing away from his body

slower ball again, and it is chops to third man! Dabs at that good length ball on middle and off really late, as he waits for it to come. There is neither a short third man nor a man at the boundary, as he jams that for a delicate four while playing close to his body
Another full ball on off, and again he pushes that toward cover. This time the batters are sure there is no single there, with a loud call of "no"
another full ball, which is straighter on off. He opens the bat face to tap that toward cover for a non-eventful ball, finally
full delivery on off, and clipped to mid-on. This time Tripathi has to dive for his life at the bowler's end, with the throw from Rayudu quick but wide of the stumps

leading edge, but just short of the diving mid-on fielder! And du Plessis is wringing his right hand after attempting that catch on running forward. The ball seemed to have just touched his fingers there. It was a slower ball on a fullish length outside leg, as Iyer mistimed his flick to send that skying to mid-on
full length ball on middle and off, and it is clipped to dine leg from deep in his crease
much fuller and just outside off. He opens the bat face to tap that to the man at that wide-ish gully, from where Jadeja has a shy at the bowler's end but doesn't hit
short delivery, and pulled to deep midwicket! He was down the track early, as he reads the length on middle and leg, and makes a touch of room to hammer that pull
good length ball on middle, and clipped to deep square leg, who is one of the two men on the boundary
change of pace. On a good length and just outside off, as Curran bowls the cutter coming into the batter. Iyer slogs, but is beaten
crunches a drive, but right to the man at cover-point. Curran pitches it up just outside off, as Tripathi lunges forward to play
good length ball just outside off, and he pushes that toward cover-point for a quick single
pretty full and pitching on leg. Angles down further for a wide, as the ball is not cleanly collected by Dhoni

direct hit from midwicket, and Gill is gone! Rayudu with the magic there. Gill came dancing down much before the ball was bowled, as Chahar pitched that on a good length on middle and leg. The ball took his front pad toward midwicket, and Gill set off for a run in a flash. But there was hardly a run there, and so Iyer remained unmoved. But by that time, Gill was already halfway down, and Rayudu had enough time to dislodge the stumps. Gill dived back, but in vain

appeal for leg before, and a delayed answer has the umpire raising his finger! But Gill reviews immediately. Seemed like an inside edge on first look. The ball pitches on a good length on middle, and angles into the batter, who goes for the flick. But the ball strikes his front pad around middle and leg, with his bat fat closed on off stump. So no inside edge clearly. And replays confirm the ball would have gone way over leg stump.
beats cover to his left! On the driving length and a touch wide of off, as Gill leans into the drive to drill that to deep point for four more

skips down, and slaps that over mid-off! Another full delivery on middle and off, as Gill makes room and dances down to loft that. The man at mid-off was wide, and even leapt to his right, but has no chance
much fuller, and on a driving length on just outside off. He opens the bat face a touch to drive to deep point, who is out on the boundary
good length ball on middle, with a hint of movement away from the batter. Tucked away to fine leg to get off the mark

length, and he gets down on one knee and slaps it towards midwicket. Never before would you have witnessed so much excitement about a routine shot across the line! CSK go back on top of the table, and do it on the basis of, excuse the cliche, an absolute humdinger!

straighter ball, and he looks to sweep this. Given out leg before! Jadeja reviews. May have just got him outside off. Though it might stay on umpire's call. Dot ball in any case. It reveals umpire's call on impact. So Jadeja will have to go back. Super Over, anybody?
fullish, and srikes him on the pads as he looks to whip it away
tickles this fine, picking it up from just around off and middle. Varun goes chasing after it from short fine leg, and just about pulls it back in. Scores level!
fullish, holds its line, and Thakur fails to make contact with an attempted drive down the ground
Curran skips down the track, and looks to clear long off, but he cannot do that. Substitute Kamlesh Nagarkoti dives low to his right and picks it off. No celebration, understandably
full toss, and deposited around backward point again. Is that game over for KKR?
full outside off, and he has squirted this through backward point. Superb placement, and CSK are marching towards this target

length, and he has lofted this over long on. What a shot! It's a bad choice of length again from Prasidh, though. Just allows him to get under this. Jadeja spanks it with superb bat speed. It got a lot of height, but importantly, also got some great distance
short, and swung over long leg. What a shot from Jadeja! That's the injection of belief they would have been looking at. That was a rather unnecessary variation from Prasidh, and was duly punished
full toss, but driven firmly to cover yet again. Just a single
fullish, around off, and driven to cover, who's quite deep on the circle
googly again, and he goes back to punch this towards deep midwicket. Just a single for Jadeja
length, goes back and punches towards cover
length, tapped towards deep midwicket with soft hands. They are able to take two

he dares! He perishes! Similar length, but this was the one that goes the other way. Tosses it up a touch. Dhoni this time has no option, with the mounting equation, but to go for a big, booming drive. That leaves a substantial gap between bat and pad, and that's exactly where the ball has gone through
length, driven to cover. No run. Close to Dhoni, both in line and length. The temptation to go for a big one is there, if he dares

fullish, driven towards long off. To the left of the man there, and they have pushed the second. It's a good bit of fielding, though, as Varun whips the bails off. Raina is well short. No third time lucky for Chinna Thala!
full, just around off, and he gets it past cover towards deep cover. Calls for two, and gets them quite easily
short, into the body. Awkward position, as the ball hits his midriff and drops to the off side. They scamper a leg bye
short, slapped down towards long on. Venkatesh Iyer is right by the boundary, and does well to ensure he stays well inside. Another twist in the tale?
whips away a full toss towards midwicket. Andre Russell gets to his right and saves a boundary with one hand, but at the end of it, he has limped just off the ground. Perhaps a heel injury?
short, down the leg side, and he fails to make contact with an attempted pull shot
full toss, and slashed away towards deep backward point. Just a single
Ferguson goes for the yorker, but gets it all wrong. Ends up as a beamer, and Raina weaves out of the way. Free hit to follow!
yorker from Ferguson to start. Played towards deep cover for a single
yorker. Chopped back towards the keeper, and they scamper for the one. Karthik tries to underarm this at the striker's end but just misses. Second close shave for Raina in the space of three balls!
fullish, driven firmly to cover. Too quick for them to consider a single
slower ball, back towards the bowler. Raina has come halfway down the pitch, and Iyer gets to it. Has a shy at the non-striker's end, but doesn't hit! Chance gone begging

full toss, just outside off, and he looks to drive this towards point. More off the edge, and it runs towards short third. A shy at the stumps at the non-striker's end. He's safely home, though. A quick referral from the umpire confirms thus
fullish, around off, and cracked away towards sweeper cover
length, from around the wicket, and he works it away with his wrists towards fine leg
length, punched to the right of cover
punched towards cover off the backfoot
length, around off, and he pulls out a gorgeous cover drive. Deep and wide enough of cover-point to pick up two
just a bit short, from round the wicket, and he has whipped it away through the vacant deep backward square leg region

timber this time! Rayudu with another ambitious skip down the wicket. Has ended up missing a length ball just outside off. Spins back just enough to come back in and tickle off. Welcome wicket for Kolkata at this stage
Iyer makes a meal of an easy pick up to his right at deep cover! Skips down the wicket and goes inside out
spins across Moeen again. Looks for the flat sweep, but misses, as the ball sneaks under his bat
skips down the wicket, and looks to loft this over long on. Holds up in the air, and lands just short of Iyer running in from the deep. He did go for it, but kept his body behind it
down the wicket, and whips a length ball towards sweeper cover
quicker, and beats him as he shapes to cut this. Very close to him
length, slashed away, but straight to point
worked with the turn into him towards midwicket
fullish, played towards mid-off. Picks a single
short, pulled away towards deep midwicket
short, and gets a pull going towards cow corner
length, around off, and cuts back to strike him on the pads. Hit him quite high though. Rayudu getting into a tangle twice in his first three balls, just looking to work it off to the onside
ful, wide, and driven firmly towards deep point
fullish, driven towards mid-off. They take a single
full, down the leg side. Will need to reload this
short, and he lofts this towards deep midwicket. Picks up two
length, cuts back from outside off at good pace, thuds into Rayudu's pads. He was outside the line, though. Trickles past Karthik towards third
short of a length, worked away towards midwicket
short, slashed, and straight to deep point. Lockie Ferguson seems to have overrun it a bit, and looking into the sun, but has done well to adjust and take it behind him to his right
length, around off, and he taps this towards point. Travels quite quickly, so that eliminates any chances of taking runs
slower ball, and he has worked this off his legs towards midwicket
length, pulled away from around off stump, and it goes away towards deep square leg
short, outside off, and he pulls this towards deep midwicket
short, down the leg side. He goes for the pull, and gets a bit of an edge off it. Karthik dives to his left, but cannot stop it
short, down the leg side, and worked down towards fine leg
width, and slapped through covers. What a gorgeous shot that from Moeen!
works this with the incoming angle towards square leg
cracked over deep square leg! Typical Moeen shot. Short of a length on middle, and he swings that away, as that pull is perfectly timed
mid-on dives to his left and deep midwicket runs across to his right, but all in vain! Low full-toss on middle and leg, and that is clipped using hsi wrists
short delivery to Moeen again, and at 143kph. Climbs on to him from middle stump, as he looks to pull, but is beaten, as the ball hits his body there off the inside edge
goes fuller on a good length on off, as Moeen taps that to point from close to his body
pulls, and on the bounce to mid-on! Another short delivery on off, and he plays with a swivel and with a good swing of the bat
back of a length ball on middle, and pulled to deep square leg's right with a little movement across off
drives this very full ball wide of off to deep point while playing away from his body
pulls this short of a length ball just outside off to deep midwicket. du Plessis immediately calls for two, and Moeen agrees
good length ball on middle, and angling in. He opens the bat face to guide that to third man
bouncer first up! Pitches that short on middle, and that takes off from the surface to climb over Moeen, who goes for the pull, but can't get bat on ball

leading edge popped to cover! Looks to flick this good length ball on middle, but perhaps plays that too early. The ball was again coming into him, and had good bounce too. Morgan leaps on grabbing at that, as Russell roars out after this much-needed wicket for Knight Riders
there in not great timing there, but it is still lofted over the bowler's head! Gaikwad makes room to this fullish ball on middle, which is angling in, and lofts that with the closed face of the bat
pretty full on off, and he taps that to cover for an easy single
turns into him off a fullish ball outside off. Pushed toward cover from the leg stump
short of a length on off, and again he is down the track to heave that to deep midwicket with the turn into him
takes a step down to this full ball on off, and pushes to long-on
good length ball on middle and leg, and turning in. Clipped to deep midwicket with the turn
full and straight on middle and off, pushed back to the right of the bowler
makes room, and Narine follows him with a fullish ball outside leg. Clipped that to fine leg, and they complete a hurried two
pretty full on off, and makes room to push that to long-off again with the full face of the bat
ticks away this good length ball on middle to short fine leg
very full on leg, and he skips down to drive it down to long-off
clears long-on with his pull! That is short of a length on middle, and he rocks back in the crease to swing that after clearing his front leg too
good length ball on leg, and turning away, as he pushes that back to the bowler
slower delivery now. Full again and a touch wide of off. du Plessis flashes at that away from his body, and doesn't connect
yorker length ball just outside off, as he looks to jam at that, but doesn't get contact. Half an appeal for caught behind, but no bat there
creams over the bowler's head with disdain! He is deep in his crease, and he makes room to this fullish ball on middle and off, and slaps that back only to look away after hitting that 149kph ball
very full on off - almost a yorker length ball - as he pushes that at mid-on for a quick single
full-toss just outside off, and swung away to third man off the outside half of the bat
drilled through the covers again! Finds the gap between cover-point and cover, as he drives at this really full ball outside off after leaning into it and going low
makes room to this good length ball, as Narine follows him and pitches that outside leg. Flicked to deep midwicket
good length ball on middle and off, and clipped to long-on

lofted again, and lofted for six this time! Pure timing and placement again, as the ball just crosses the long-off boundary. Again he dances down to this full ball on off, and lifts that elegantly for the maximum
this is short and wide of off, and is cut to cover-point from deep in his crease
chips that over mid-off, and four! Again he comes down to a full ball on off, and simply presents the full face of the bat to loft that for another boundary
full ball on off, as he comes down to clip that between the two men in the deep for a couple, as the ball turns into him
another really full ball on off, which is pushed toward cover
very full and straight on off, and defended back to the bowler
this time finds the gap between cover and cover-point! Shortish in length just outside off, and the ball doesn't quite get up. But du Plessis still cuts that perfectly
long-off runs to his left and dives, but still can't stop that! Good effort from Iyer, as du Plessis drives this full ball outside off all along the ground for four
comes down a step to this good length ball on off, which is coming into him, and pushes that to mid-on with the full face of the bat
full ball on middle and leg, and sliding down further. Flicked toward deep square off his pads
fumble by Gill at cover, but there is no scope of a run there. Gaikwad pushes at that full ball in the driving length outside off, but finds the fielder
on a back of a length on middle, and du Plessis clips that to deep square leg with a hop in the crease
much fuller on off, and he taps that to point really late

makes room, skips down and rams that over the bowler's head! It is again on a good length and just outside off, and the room that du Plessis has given himself means there is enough space for a full swing of the arms
on a good length, and straighter and closer to the batter. Tapped to the on side from deep in his crease
flicks this elegantly between midwicket and mid-on! Full ball on middle and off, and du Plessis backs away a touch to clip that fluently for four

and this time Karthik dives to his left to stop that on the bounce. Another good length ball on middle and leg, and angling down leg. Tucks that off his pads, but the keeper keeps that down to a dot. Crucial runs saved again
Morgan dives to his left and cover, and possibly saves four! Another crunching drive off the front foot off this full ball just outside off, but this time Gaikwad doesn't find the gap
continues bowing back of a length on middle, as Gaikwad tucks that to midwicket with his bottom hand off, perhaps because that seemed to have bounced more than he expected

another good length delivery just outside off, as he pushes that to mid-on and sets off for a rapid run
fullish on middle and off, and clipped to the man at square leg

full and straight on middle and off. Pushed with the closed face of the bat to mid-on
